# Morning Routine

What I aim for, what actually happens.

## Aim

- Wake 05:30, no alarm if possible.
- Deep work block 06:00–07:30, no phone, no inbox.
- Walk + coffee 07:30–08:00.
- First admin window 08:00–09:00 — only then check messages.

## Reality

It happens 3-4 days out of 7. Phone is the failure mode. When the
phone enters the bedroom the next morning is gone. Connection:
[[areas/personal/reading-list-2026|Deep Work]] makes the same point
about "shallow defaults."

^morning-rules
